mapper.select: SELECT B_MAIN_NO AS bMainNo, CASE WHEN B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE B_MAIN_TYPE END AS bMainType FROM BOARD_TYPE_MAIN ORDER BY B_MAIN_NO

SELECT B_SUB_NO AS bSubNo, B_MAIN_NO AS bMainNo, CASE WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE B_SUB_TYPE END AS bSubType FROM BOARD_TYPE_SUB ORDER BY B_MAIN_NO, B_SUB_NO

SELECT LOCAL_NO AS localNo, CASE WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'SEO' THEN '서울' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'INC' THEN '인천' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'PUS' THEN '부산' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'DAE' THEN '대구' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GWA' THEN '광주' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'DAJ' THEN '대전' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'ULS' THEN '울산' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'SEJ' THEN '세종' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GYE' THEN '경기' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GAN' THEN '강원' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'CHU' THEN '충청' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'JEO' THEN '전라' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'GYS' THEN '경상' WHEN LOCAL_NAME = 'JEJ' THEN '제주' ELSE LOCAL_NAME END AS localName FROM BOARD_TYPE_LOCAL ORDER BY LOCAL_NO

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.B_SUB_NO AS bSubNo, B.LOCAL_NO AS localNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.B_CONTENT AS bContent, B.USER_ID AS userId, IFNULL(U.NICKNAME, B.USER_ID) AS writerNickname, B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, B.B_STATUS AS bStatus, B.PRIVATE AS privateYn, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(B.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime,
CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE BTS.B_SUB_TYPE END AS bSubType,
CASE WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE END AS bMainType,
IFNULL(LK.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS likeCnt, IFNULL(CM.COMMENT_CNT, 0) AS commentCnt, BF.FILE_PATH AS filePath, BF.FILE_NAME AS fileName, CONCAT(BF.FILE_PATH, BF.FILE_NAME) AS thumbnail
FROM BOARD B
INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO
INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_MAIN BTM ON BTS.B_MAIN_NO = BTM.B_MAIN_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM BOARD_LIKE GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) LK ON B.BOARD_NO = LK.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM COMMENT GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) CM ON B.BOARD_NO = CM.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, MIN(FILE_NO) AS FILE_NO FROM BOARD_FILE GROUP BY BOARD_NO ) BFM ON B.BOARD_NO = BFM.BOARD_NO
LEFT JOIN BOARD_FILE BF ON BFM.FILE_NO = BF.FILE_NO
LEFT JOIN USERS U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
WHERE 1 = 1
AND B.B_STATUS = 'T' AND B.USER_ID = #{sessionId}
AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y'
AND BTM.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo}
AND BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = #{integratedCategory}
AND BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = #{localCategory}
AND B.LOCAL_NO = #{localNo}
AND (
B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
B.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN B.BOARD_NO ELSE NULL END DESC,
likeCnt DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
B.VIEW_COUNT DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
commentCnt DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
B.BOARD_NO DESC
LIMIT #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}

SELECT FILE_NO AS fileNo, BOARD_NO AS boardNo, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, ORIGIN_NAME AS originName, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, FILE_EXT AS fileExt, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS fileUrl FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo, C.C_CONTENT AS cContent, C.USER_ID AS userId, IFNULL(NULLIF(U.NICKNAME, ''), C.USER_ID) AS writerNickname, C.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, C.PARENT_NO AS parentNo, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(C.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM COMMENT C LEFT JOIN USERS U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE C.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN C.PARENT_NO IS NULL THEN C.COMMENT_NO ELSE C.PARENT_NO END ASC, C.PARENT_NO ASC, C.COMMENT_NO ASC

SELECT ALARM_NO AS alarmNo, RECEIVER_ID AS receiverId, SENDER_ID AS senderId, BOARD_NO AS boardNo, COMMENT_NO AS commentNo, ALARM_TYPE AS alarmType, ALARM_CONTENT AS alarmContent, READ_YN AS readYn, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate FROM BOARD_ALARM WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{sessionId} ORDER BY ALARM_NO DESC
SELECT KEYWORD FROM BAD_WORD WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BAD_WORD_NO ASC

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.B_SUB_NO AS bSubNo, B.LOCAL_NO AS localNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.B_CONTENT AS bContent, B.USER_ID AS userId, IFNULL(NULLIF(U.NICKNAME, ''), B.USER_ID) AS writerNickname, B.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, B.B_STATUS AS bStatus, B.PRIVATE AS privateYn, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(B.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime,
CASE WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'NTC' THEN '공지사항' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GEN' THEN '일반' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'INF' THEN '정보/팁' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'GIF' THEN '움짤' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'VID' THEN '동영상' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'QNA' THEN '질문' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MAR' THEN '나눔/장터' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'WALK' THEN '산책' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MEET' THEN '소모임' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'TRAVEL' THEN '여행팸' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'LINFO' THEN '지역정보' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'CARE' THEN '돌봄' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'MARKET' THEN '중고거래' WHEN BTS.B_SUB_TYPE = 'HOSP' THEN '병원 추천' ELSE BTS.B_SUB_TYPE END AS bSubType,
CASE WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'ALL' THEN '통합' WHEN BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE = 'LOC' THEN '지역' ELSE BTM.B_MAIN_TYPE END AS bMainType,
CASE WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'SEO' THEN '서울' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'INC' THEN '인천' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'PUS' THEN '부산' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'DAE' THEN '대구' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GWA' THEN '광주' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'DAJ' THEN '대전' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'ULS' THEN '울산' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'SEJ' THEN '세종' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GYE' THEN '경기' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GAN' THEN '강원' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'CHU' THEN '충청' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'JEO' THEN '전라' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'GYS' THEN '경상' WHEN BTL.LOCAL_NAME = 'JEJ' THEN '제주' ELSE BTL.LOCAL_NAME END AS localName
FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO INNER JOIN BOARD_TYPE_MAIN BTM ON BTS.B_MAIN_NO = BTM.B_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_LOCAL BTL ON B.LOCAL_NO = BTL.LOCAL_NO LEFT JOIN USERS U ON B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B_SUB_NO AS bSubNo, LOCAL_NO AS localNo, TITLE AS title, B_CONTENT AS bContent, USER_ID AS userId, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, B_STATUS AS bStatus, PRIVATE AS privateYn, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B_STATUS != 'N'

SELECT COMMENT_NO AS commentNo, C_CONTENT AS cContent, USER_ID AS userId, BOARD_NO AS boardNo, PARENT_NO AS parentNo, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo}
SELECT FILE_NO AS fileNo, BOARD_NO AS boardNo, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, ORIGIN_NAME AS originName FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}

SELECT BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B_SUB_NO AS bSubNo, LOCAL_NO AS localNo, TITLE AS title, B_CONTENT AS bContent, PRIVATE AS privateYn, B_STATUS AS bStatus FROM BOARD WHERE USER_ID = #{sessionId} AND B_STATUS = 'T' ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD B WHERE B.B_STATUS = 'Y' AND B.PRIVATE = 'N' AND B.BOARD_NO < #{boardNo} ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title FROM BOARD B WHERE B.B_STATUS = 'Y' AND B.PRIVATE = 'N' AND B.BOARD_NO > #{boardNo} ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO ASC LIMIT 1

, #{reportReason}, 'WAI', NOW() )

NULL
, #{title}, #{bContent}, #{userId}, 0, #{bStatus}, #{privateYn}, NOW(), NOW() )

, #{alarmType}, #{alarmContent}, 'N', NOW() )
